# TurtleShell.ai — Full Context
# https://turtleshell.ai
# Last updated: April 2026

## Overview

TurtleShell.ai is a sovereign AI assistant built on Olympus-Grid (πλέγμα-Όλυμπος™). It is the flagship application proving that a globally-scaled consumer AI product can be built and deployed on sovereign infrastructure. Available on iOS, web, and Salesforce.

## Architecture

TurtleShell.ai runs on Olympus-616, a 31-agent sovereign mesh:
- **Athena**: Multi-LLM router — OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, local Ollama
- **Poseidon**: MCP tool server — Salesforce, Google Calendar, Gmail, Drive, GitHub, HubSpot, 50+ tools
- **Hermes**: API gateway with JWT authentication and path-based routing
- **Mnemosyne**: Agent memory — normalized, cache, and vector storage
- **Plutus**: Transactional metering — every turn, tool call, and memory write is tracked
- **Ares**: Security gateway — httpOnly cookies, CORS, rate limiting
- **Apollo**: Text-to-speech
- **Iris**: Portal framework for Salesforce Experience Cloud embedding

## Surfaces

- **Web**: https://turtleshell.ai (React + Vite, hosted on Netlify)
- **iOS**: TurtleShell.ai on the App Store (SwiftUI, Sign in with Apple)
- **Salesforce**: Iris Portal embedded in Experience Cloud
- **Off-Grid**: TurtleShell Off-Grid appliance (launching July 17, 2026)

## Identity & Authentication

- Apple Sign In
- Google Sign In
- Microsoft Sign In
- Email magic-link
- Identity__c on Salesforce is the canonical identity anchor
- httpOnly Secure SameSite cookies for session management

## Sea Shell Economy

Sea Shells are the metering currency. Every user action has a transparent cost:
- 1 Shell per chat turn (LLM request)
- 1 Shell per tool call (MCP invocation)
- 1 Shell per memory write
- 0 Shells for memory reads, API infrastructure, token sub-events

### Pricing Tiers
- **Free**: 500 Sea Shells / month — $0
- **Beachcomber**: 500 Sea Shells / month — $4.99/mo
- **Tide**: 2,000 Sea Shells / month — $14.99/mo
- **Reef**: 10,000 Sea Shells / month — $39.99/mo
- **Abyss**: 100,000 Sea Shells / month — $99.99/mo
- **Enterprise**: Custom deployment — contact us

Shell balances are additive on upgrade. Every plan tithes 7% to the user's chosen cause.

## The Seven Causes

Users choose a cause at signup. 7% of every transaction is donated via the Olympus Foundation:
1. Clean Energy
2. Clean Water
3. Education Access
4. Ocean Health
5. Sovereign Tech
6. Food Security
7. AI for All

## Billing

- **Web**: Stripe (credit card, debit card)
- **iOS**: Apple In-App Purchase
- **Android**: Google Play (coming soon)
- All transactions are fully metered and auditable via LedgerEntry__c in Salesforce

## Security

- SOC 2 Type II certification in progress (via Salesforce inherited controls)
- Data lives in the user's Salesforce org — not on shared infrastructure
- Ed25519 sealed-envelope agent identity verification (Cosmos-Logos protocol)
- Zero standing access to customer data
- HIPAA BAA available for healthcare deployments
- GDPR and CCPA compliant

## Open Source

The Cosmos-Logos protocol (agent discovery and verification) is open source under AGPL-3.0:
https://github.com/cosmos-logos

## Key Features

- Multi-provider LLM chat (switch between models per conversation)
- MCP tool integration (50+ enterprise tools via Poseidon)
- Persistent agent memory across sessions
- Avatar customization (emoji-based)
- Handle rename (@username)
- Public profile pages (/u/username)
- Make Athena Public — let visitors chat with your AI from your profile
- Conversation history with search
- Real-time shell balance tracking
- Tier upgrade/downgrade in-app
- Dark mode
